summary: This Makefile snippet defines a variable that extracts the GitHub repository URL from your local Git configuration and converts it to HTTPS format if needed, then provides a make target that opens that repository in your default web browser.

explanations.1: This line runs a shell command that grabs your Git remote URL, uses sed to convert SSH format (git@github.com:user/repo.git) to HTTPS format (https://github.com/user/repo), and then grep extracts just the base URL without the .git extension.
explanations.4: The @ symbol suppresses echoing the command itself to the terminal, so you only see the browser opening, not the command that triggered it.
